typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	hasErrored as boolean (),
	WcfErrorMsg as string ()
}

source(output(
		ImportId as integer,
		Date as date,
		Tenor as double,
		Value as double,
		SubCategoryId as integer,
		ClientAgentId as integer,
		ClientId as integer,
		ClientLocationId as integer,
		UserId as integer,
		Description as string,
		Error as string,
		namespace as string,
		CurveId as integer,
		MDCurveId as long,
		status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ImportId, Date, Tenor, Value, SubCategoryId, ClientAgentId, ClientId, ClientLocationId, UserId, Description, Error, namespace, CurveId, MDCurveId, status  FROM [Staging].[UserDefinedCurveTransform]   WHERE [Status]=\'Loaded Curve\' AND CurveId IS NOT NULL AND MdCurveId IS NOT NULL AND Error IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		id as long,
		curveId as long,
		versionNumber as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Curves.Version',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupVersionLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupVersionLKPTABLE lookup(MDCurveId == LookupVersionLKPTABLE@curveId,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupVersion
LookupVersion filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupVersion
FilterLookupVersion select(mapColumn(
		VersionId = id,
		{} = {}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupVersionREFORMAT
LookupVersionREFORMAT sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = _namespace)) ~> Update
